title: I Ran the Petty Revenge All the Way Through the Suggestion Box

parts.text: I found my lunch labeled with a sticky note that said obvious. I am twenty-three, first office job, Tupperware, still learning. Rhea had been eating around my name like a game. The break room coffee burned. My yogurt, peach, specific brand, was half gone. I had written PRIYA in Sharpie on the lid. A new note said obvious in her looping script, the same as the fridge policy cards. Rhea said, "If you don't want sharing, don't use the communal fridge" I said, "It's labeled" Dana from payroll saw my face and pretended to rinse a mug. I can still name the ugly little detail, which is how I know it happened. I noticed a scuff on the floor shaped like a comma, which fit i. Someone had left a receipt in the cup holder, faded blue ink. The air tasted like leftover rain and cleaning spray, which fit i. A cheap clock on the wall jumped a minute late, then caught up. I kept my keys in my left pocket so I would not fidget, which fit i. The plastic chair stuck to my legs when I shifted. A vending machine hummed in another room like a bored insect, which fit i. I counted three ceiling tiles with water stains before I spoke again.
parts.cliffhanger_hint: Half my peach yogurt is gone, and her handwriting is on the policy cards too.

parts.text: I printed a sheet: label your food or it gets logged. I logged missing items for two weeks with dates, like a gremlin librarian. Peach yogurt, Tuesday. Turkey, Thursday. Rhea's sparkling water, never missing. I put the log on the fridge with the same magnet as her policies. People initialed their losses. Rhea called it middle school. HR asked why the fridge looked like a crime board. I said because it was. HR said, "Who started the log" Rhea said, "She's creating a culture issue" The magnet was a tiny corn, dairy vendor leftover. I can still name the ugly little detail, which is how I know it happened. I noticed a scuff on the floor shaped like a comma, which fit i. I counted three ceiling tiles with water stains before I spoke again.

parts.text: I suggested, via the official box, locked cameras or locked fridges. They chose a mini fridge with locks for a pilot on our floor. I got a key. Rhea got a key. My yogurt lived. She called it a waste. I called it peach. Dana brought granola as a truce snack for the room, not for Rhea specifically. I still write PRIYA. Obvious was her word. Accurate was the log. Petty revenge, in my version, is logistics that outlive a sticky note. The coffee still burns. Some things you cannot fix. Dana said, "You winning" I said, "I'm eating lunch" I ate peach yogurt at my desk, loudly enough to be a little rude, then not.
